1月上中旬至下旬富士山雪冠突出，适合清晨湖景与干冷晴空摄影。: Early to mid-January to late January Mount Fuji snow cap is prominent, suitable for early morning lake views and dry clear sky photography.
1月上中旬草千里可能出现积雪、冰冻池塘及火山岩薄雪景观。: Early to mid-January Kusasenri may exhibit snow accumulation, frozen ponds, and volcanic rock thin snow landscapes.
1月上中旬适合海岸公路摄影，冷锋间歇晴天可拍跨海大桥。: Early to mid-January is suitable for coastal highway photography, with clear skies between cold fronts allowing photos of cross-sea bridges.
1月上中旬重点关注足立美术馆枯山水雪景、城崎温泉雪夜与松叶蟹。: Early to mid-January focuses on Adachi Museum of Art dry landscape snow scenery, Kinosaki Onsen snowy nights, and Matsuba crab.
1月上中旬重点拍摄金鳞湖热雾、铁轮温泉蒸汽及温泉旅馆雪景。: Early to mid-January focuses on photographing Kinrin Lake thermal mist, Kannawa Onsen steam, and hot spring inn snow scenery.
1月上旬新年寺社参拜，冷空气南下时东山与古寺可能出现短暂积雪。: Early January New Year shrine visits; when cold air moves south, Higashiyama and ancient temples may experience brief snow accumulation.
1月上旬新年寺院参拜，1月中下旬适合晴空塔与六本木远摄雪冠富士山。: Early January New Year temple visits, mid-to-late January suitable for telephoto shooting of snow-capped Mount Fuji from Tokyo Skytree and Roppongi.
1月上旬神社初诣人流较多，中下旬更适合安静古道摄影。: Early January shrine Hatsumode crowds are heavy, mid-to-late January is more suitable for quiet ancient trail photography.
1月上旬神社新年参拜气氛浓厚，冬季低角度阳光突出建筑轮廓。: Early January shrine New Year visit atmosphere is strong, winter low-angle sunlight highlights architectural outlines.
1月上旬至2月下旬，日落前30分钟至日落后45分钟，降雪初停时最佳。: Early January to late February, 30 minutes before sunset to 45 minutes after sunset, best right after snowfall stops.
1月下旬至2月下旬，来自日本海方向的冷湿季风携带过冷水滴，在藏王亚高山针叶树上冻: Late January to late February, cold and humid monsoons from the Sea of Japan carry supercooled water droplets, freezing and capturing snowfall on Zao subalpine conifers; Ginzan Onsen maintains snow cover through repeated snowfalls and sustained low temperatures during the same period.
1月下旬至2月下旬，重点优先2月中旬；晴天09:00–11:30。: Late January to late February, focusing primarily on mid-February; clear days 09:00–11:30.
1月下旬至2月下旬；下午自然蓝冰与日落后灯饰适合连续拍摄。: Late January to late February; natural blue ice in the afternoon and illuminations after sunset are suitable for continuous shooting.
1月下旬至3月上旬的列车实际运行日，尤其适合晴冷清晨及低温积雪天气。: Actual train operation days from late January to early March, particularly suitable for clear, cold mornings and low-temperature snowy weather.
1月下旬若草山烧山传统活动通常举行，具体日期及是否实施须查官方公告。: Late January Wakakusayama Yamayaki traditional event is usually held, check official announcements for specific dates and implementation.
1月中下旬五棱郭雪堡，月底支笏湖冰涛祭通常陆续开启。: Mid-to-late January Goryokaku snow fort, with Lake Shikotsu Ice Festival usually opening successively at the end of the month.
1月中下旬优先安排地狱谷雪猴，松本城寻找新雪与黑天守对比。: Mid-to-late January prioritizes Jigokudani snow monkeys, with Matsumoto Castle searching for contrasts between fresh snow and the black keep.
1月中下旬冲绳北部寒绯樱逐步开放，庆良间进入座头鲸观赏季；屋久岛高山可能积雪。: Mid-to-late January northern Okinawa Kanhi cherry blossoms gradually bloom, Kerama enters the humpback whale watching season; Yakushima alpine areas may have snow.
1月中下旬合掌造积雪与官方预约制点灯活动，2027年共有四场。: Mid-to-late January Gassho-style snow accumulation and official reservation-only illumination events, with four sessions total in 2027.
1月中下旬官方指定点灯日且提前取得有效门票，活动前寒潮带来积雪；5月中下旬稻田注: Late January during the official designated illumination days with advance valid tickets secured, preceded by a cold wave bringing snow; mid-to-late May on clear mornings with low wind speed after paddy fields are flooded.
1月中下旬寒潮后兼六园雪吊与茶屋街积雪最有冬季画面感。: In late January following a cold wave, Kenroku-en's yukitsuri and the snowy chaya districts offer the ultimate winter atmosphere.
1月中下旬晴空夜景通透，大栈桥与未来港适合长焦摄影。: Clear night views in late January; Osanbashi Pier and Minato Mirai are ideal for telephoto photography.
1月中下旬海港夜景通透，六甲山可能出现薄雪与雾凇。: Clear harbor night views in late January; Mount Rokko may feature light snow and rime ice.
1月中下旬白墙老街人流较少，适合晨间运河倒影。: Fewer crowds in the white-walled old streets in late January, ideal for morning canal reflections.
1月中下旬积雪稳定，孤树、丘陵和白须瀑布适合极简摄影。: Stable snow cover in late January; the lone tree, rolling hills, and Shirahige Waterfall are ideal for minimalist photography.
1月中下旬适合七里滨富士山远摄及江之岛冬季灯饰。: Late January is ideal for telephoto shots of Mount Fuji from Shichirigahama and the Enoshima winter illuminations.
1月中下旬适合西表岛森林活动，北部海岸注意强风。: Late January is suitable for forest activities on Iriomote Island; watch out for strong winds on the northern coast.
1月中下旬银山温泉雪夜逐渐稳定，藏王树冰持续成长，青森白色美术馆融入雪地。: In late January, the snowy nights at Ginza Onsen gradually stabilize, Zao Snow Monsters continue to grow, and Towada Art Center blends into the snowscape.
1月中下旬高海拔可能积雪，普通游客以低地森林及海岸为主。: High altitudes may have snow in late January; ordinary travelers should focus on lowland forests and coasts.
1月中下旬鹤居村晨雾、树霜摄影；1月下旬流冰船通常开始运行。: Morning mist and frost photography in Tsurui village in late January; drift ice cruises typically begin operating in late January.
1月中旬–2月下旬09:00–11:30低温降雪后: Mid-January to late February, 09:00–11:30, following low temperatures and snowfall.
1月中旬–2月中旬积雪后的08:00–10:00；11月中下旬清晨: 08:00–10:00 after snowfall from mid-January to mid-February; early morning in late November.
1月中旬至2月下旬低温雪季；夏季上午光线柔和时。: Low-temperature snow season from mid-January to late February; during soft morning light in summer.
1月中旬至2月中旬寒潮可能给奈良及吉野山区带来短时积雪，山地雪景概率高于奈良市区: Cold waves from mid-January to mid-February may bring brief snow to Nara and the Yoshino mountains, with higher chances of mountain snowscapes than in Nara city. Do not enter closed trails during snow and icy road conditions.
1月中旬至2月中旬日出前后，通常以无强风、极寒的清晨更有机会出现河雾。: Around sunrise from mid-January to mid-February; early mornings with no strong winds and extreme cold offer a higher chance of river mist.
1月中旬至2月中旬雪后清晨；6月下旬至8月中旬农田色彩丰富。: Morning after snowfall from mid-January to mid-February; rich farmland colors from late June to mid-August.
1月中旬至下旬头大佛殿雪丘、朝里站雪海与藻岩山灯海。: Snow hills at the Great Buddha Hall, the snow-covered sea at Asari Station, and the light-filled sea of Mount Moiwa in mid-to-late January.
2027年活动已公布为1月30日至2月23日。尽量在下午入场同时记录天然蓝冰和夜: The 2027 event is scheduled from January 30 to February 23. Enter in the afternoon to capture both natural blue ice and night illuminations; specific opening rules are subject to official announcements. Drones are prohibited. 2月上中旬关注兼六园冬季特别开放及雪景。: In early-to-mid February, focus on Kenroku-en's special winter opening and snow scenery.
2月上中旬冲绳寒绯樱与座头鲸为重点，长崎港口冬季夜景空气较清透。: In early-to-mid February, focus on Okinawa's cold-bloomed cherry blossoms and humpback whales; Nagasaki port's winter night views feature clearer air.
2月上中旬可拍安静的竹富岛传统街巷。: In early-to-mid February, capture quiet traditional alleyways on Taketomi Island.
2月上中旬寒潮可能使鸟取砂丘出现白雪覆盖的特殊形态。: In early-to-mid February, cold waves may cause the Tottori Sand Dunes to take on a special snow-covered form.
2月上中旬广岛牡蛎处于冬季主要品尝季，宫岛游客相对较少。: In early-to-mid February, Hiroshima oysters are in their prime winter tasting season, and Miyajima has relatively fewer tourists.
2月上中旬支笏湖蓝冰建筑、函馆冬季灯饰与积雪坡道。: In early-to-mid February, Lake Shikotsu blue ice structures, Hakodate winter illuminations, and snow-covered slopes.
2月上中旬至下旬是藏王树冰核心观赏窗口，银山温泉深雪与夜灯同步处于冬季摄影旺季。: From early-to-mid to late February is the core viewing window for Zao Snow Monsters; Ginza Onsen's deep snow and night lights coincide with the peak winter photography season.
2月上中旬适合雪村白昼摄影，但2027年官方点灯没有安排在2月。: Early-to-mid February is suitable for daytime snow village photography, but official illuminations are not scheduled for February in 2027.
2月上中旬雪原成熟，晴冷清晨可能出现树挂。: In early-to-mid February, snowfields are mature, and clear, cold mornings may feature rime ice.
2月上中旬雪猴温泉蒸汽画面突出，轻井泽森林雪景适合极简建筑摄影。: In early-to-mid February, snow monkey hot spring steam scenes stand out, and Karuizawa forest snowscapes are ideal for minimalist architectural photography.
2月上旬札幌冰雪节与2月上中旬小樽雪灯之路，具体日期逐年调整。: Sapporo Snow Festival in early February and Otaru Snow Light Path in early-to-mid February; specific dates adjust annually.
2月上旬至3月上旬的年度批准开放期间，优先选择天气稳定的上午。: During the annually approved opening period from early February to early March, prioritize mornings with stable weather.
2月上旬至中旬依年度雪灯活动安排，持续低温维持冰雪灯罩；7月中旬至下旬薰衣草在春: Depending on the annual snow light event schedule from early to mid-February, continuous low temperatures maintain the ice and snow lanterns; from mid-to-late July, lavender enters full bloom after spring/summer effective accumulated temperature and sunshine requirements are met, which may be delayed in a cold spring.
2月上旬至中旬雪灯之路活动期间；日落后20–40分钟拍摄蓝调灯火。: During the Snow Light Path event from early to mid-February; shoot blue hour lights 20–40 minutes after sunset.
2月下旬可关注早春梅花，山城仍保持低角度冬季光影。: In late February, look out for early spring plum blossoms, and the mountain castle maintains low-angle winter light and shadow.
2月中下旬低地逐渐回暖，适合白滨海蚀岩和短程朝圣步道。: In mid-to-late February, lowlands gradually warm up, making it ideal for Shirahama sea-cut rocks and short pilgrimage trails.
2月中下旬冬末梅花与美术馆清冷光影。: Late-winter plum blossoms and the cold light and shadow of art museums in mid-to-late February.
2月中下旬冬草与霜冻，晴日拍摄外轮山层叠山脊。: Winter grass and frost in mid-to-late February; shoot the overlapping ridges of the outer rim mountains on clear days.
2月中下旬北野天满宫梅苑进入赏梅季，清水寺冬晨人流相对较少。: Kitano Tenmangu's plum orchard enters the plum-viewing season in mid-to-late February, and Kiyomizu-dera has relatively fewer crowds on winter mornings.
2月中下旬古寺梅花开放，富士山仍保有明显雪冠。: Plum blossoms bloom at ancient temples in mid-to-late February, and Mount Fuji still retains a clear snowcap.
2月中下旬可寻找积雪湖岸、忠灵塔雪景及箱根温泉蒸汽。: In mid-to-late February, look for snow-covered lake shores, Chureito Pagoda in the snow, and Hakone hot spring steam.
2月中下旬大阪城梅林逐渐进入主要观赏期。: Osaka Castle Plum Grove gradually enters its prime viewing period in mid-to-late February.
2月中下旬太宰府梅花逐渐盛开，清晨金鳞湖仍有热雾机会。: Dazaifu plum blossoms gradually bloom in mid-to-late February, and Kinrin Lake still offers chances of thermal mist in the early morning.
2月中下旬梅花陆续开放，红砖仓库冬季活动以年度公告为准。: Plum blossoms bloom successively in mid-to-late February, and Red Brick Warehouse winter events are subject to annual announcements.
2月中下旬汤岛天神等地梅花开放，冷空气过境后的晴晨适合都市长焦摄影。: Plum blossoms bloom at Yushima Tenjin and other locations in mid-to-late February; clear mornings after cold air passes are ideal for urban telephoto photography.
2月中下旬片冈梅林红白梅逐渐开放，可结合春日大社冬季森林摄影。: Kataoka Plum Grove's red and white plum blossoms gradually bloom in mid-to-late February, which can be combined with winter forest photography at Kasuga Taisha.
